scorecards.full_name: Maharashtra State Electricity Distribution Company Limited
scorecards.regulation: Maharashtra Electricity Regulatory Commission (Electricity Supply Code and Standards of Performance of Distribution Licensees including Power Quality) Regulations, 2021 | Maharashtra Electricity Regulatory Commission (Electricity Supply Code and Standards of Performance of Distribution Licensees including Power Quality) (First Amendment) Regulations, 2024.
scorecards.gap: Reports the fullest indicator set of any licensee, but standard/reported units are inconsistent (minutes vs. resolved-% vs. Hr:Min) and most benchmarks (90-99%) are missed by wide margins.

scorecards.regulation: Gujarat Electricity Regulatory Commission (Standards of Performance of Distribution Licensees) Regulations, 2023.
scorecards.gap: Reliability indicators (SAIDI/SAIFI/MAIFI/CAIDI) have no GERC benchmark to compare against; power-quality sample tests pass at ~100%.

scorecards.regulation: Gujarat Electricity Regulatory Commission (Standards of Performance of Distribution Licensees) Regulations, 2023.
scorecards.gap: Same regulatory gap as other Gujarat DISCOMs on reliability; billing complaint resolution is the weakest metric at 50.4%.

scorecards.regulation: Gujarat Electricity Regulatory Commission (Standards of Performance of Distribution Licensees) Regulations, 2023.
scorecards.gap: Billing complaint resolution is the lowest in the dataset (29.7%); reliability indicators remain non-comparable under GERC rules.

scorecards.regulation: Gujarat Electricity Regulatory Commission (Standards of Performance of Distribution Licensees) Regulations, 2023.
scorecards.gap: SAIDI (~209 hrs/yr) and SAIFI (~95/yr) are order-of-magnitude outliers versus peers — worth verifying at source.

scorecards.full_name: Madhya Pradesh Poorv Kshetra Vidyut Vitaran Company Limited
scorecards.regulation: Madhya Pradesh Electricity Regulatory Commission (Distribution Performance Standards) Regulations, 2004
scorecards.gap: Reports zero data for all four reliability and two power-quality indicators; only billing/transformer-restoration are populated (and pass at ~100%).

scorecards.full_name: Madhya Pradesh Paschim Kshetra Vidyut Vitaran Company Limited
scorecards.regulation: Madhya Pradesh Electricity Regulatory Commission (Distribution Performance Standards) Regulations, 2004
scorecards.gap: Same reporting pattern as MPEZ — reliability & power-quality indicators entirely unreported for 2021-22.

scorecards.full_name: Madhya Pradesh Madhya Kshetra Vidyut Vitaran Company Limited
scorecards.regulation: Madhya Pradesh Electricity Regulatory Commission (Distribution Performance Standards) Regulations, 2004
scorecards.gap: Same reporting pattern as MPEZ/MPWZ — reliability & power-quality indicators entirely unreported for 2021-22.

scorecards.regulation: RERC ( Standards of Performance for Distribution Licensees) Regulations, 2021
scorecards.gap: The most fully comparable licensee in the dataset — RERC benchmarks exist and are met for SAIDI, SAIFI, voltage variation, transformer restoration and billing.

scorecards.regulation: RERC ( Standards of Performance for Distribution Licensees) Regulations, 2021
scorecards.gap: Every indicator is tagged "Comparison Possible: Yes" and "Standard Met: Yes" in the source sheet, yet not a single value was actually reported — a reporting-integrity gap, not a real result.

scorecards.regulation: RERC ( Standards of Performance for Distribution Licensees) Regulations, 2021
scorecards.gap: Second-most complete licensee after AVVNL; meets its RERC benchmarks across reliability, voltage variation, transformer restoration and billing.

scorecards.full_name: Tata Power Central Odisha Distribution Limited
scorecards.regulation: ORISSA ELECTRICITY REGULATORY COMMISSION (LICENSEES' STANDARDS OF PERFORMANCE) REGULATIONS, 2004
scorecards.gap: SAIDI (~155 hrs/yr) is a major outlier; its billing indicator measures bill accuracy (% faulty bills), not complaint-resolution speed, so it can't be charted against other states' billing metric.

scorecards.full_name: Tata Power North Odisha Distribution Limited
scorecards.regulation: ORISSA ELECTRICITY REGULATORY COMMISSION (LICENSEES' STANDARDS OF PERFORMANCE) REGULATIONS, 2004
scorecards.gap: No reliability, power-quality, or service data reported for 2021-22 — only benchmark/standard metadata exists in the sheet.
